source: Once blocks are resident, warp schedulers choose eligible warps and issue their instructions to the appropriate execution paths. Some warps may wait on memory or dependencies while others proceed. As blocks complete, their resources are freed and later blocks can become resident.
zh: 一旦块驻留，warp 调度程序就会选择符合条件的 warp 并向适当的执行路径发出指令。某些扭曲可能会等待内存或依赖项，而其他扭曲则继续进行。当块完成时，它们的资源被释放，之后的块可以成为常驻的。
